S.FORM: pslkotas babaw kmnloh 'bagan lga, pslkotas qu qalang Tayal la. msli kuwara qu qutux niqan, qmasuw pcyuwagun, psqqas grhuw ryax. tehuk ryax lga, msqun tegalu ki mlawa Utux Wagiq ru utux bnkis, msqun mquwas ru mzyugi smqqas ki mplaw maniq. pslkotas hya ga psqutux inlungan qalang ki 'mubuy psglabang gaga Tayal.
S.PHON: p[s|ɕ]lkota[s|ɕ] βaβaw kmnloħ ʔβaɣan lɣa p[s|ɕ]lkota[s|ɕ] qu qalaŋ tajal la m[s|ɕ]li kuwara qu qutux niqan qma[s|ɕ]uw p[ʦ|ʨ]juwaɣun p[s|ɕ]qqa[s|ɕ] ɣrħuw rjax teħuk rjax lɣa m[s|ɕ]qun teɣalu ki mlawa utux waɣiq ru utux βnki[s|ɕ] m[s|ɕ]qun mquwa[s|ɕ] ru mzjuɣi [s|ɕ]mqqa[s|ɕ] ki mplaw maniq p[s|ɕ]lkota[s|ɕ] ħja ɣa p[s|ɕ]qutux inluŋan qalaŋ ki ʔmuβuj p[s|ɕ]ɣlaβaŋ ɣaɣa tajal
